description: This is a unit test class for the ReportingMethodConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM system, specifically testing the service's methods for managing reporting methods, including listing, retrieving by ID or name, saving, deleting, and counting reporting methods.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ReportingMethodConfigurationService in the OrangeHRM Pim plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating the service instance and loading test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of ReportingMethod entities via the service, mocking the DAO layer.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ReportingMethod by its ID.

methods.name: testDeleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Tests deleting a list of reporting methods.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Tests retrieving a ReportingMethod by its name.

methods.name: testGetReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Tests counting reporting methods based on filter parameters.
